Build Process

How to build plugins manually:

   1. Make sure that you don't have any special characters in your Eclipse installation path (this includes whitespaces)
      >confirmed on MacOS running Ganymede RC2
   2. Select "Export" from the context menu of your plugin
   3. Select "Plugin Development">"Deployable plugins and fragments"
   4. Follow the steps on the wizard.
